div.head: List of persons mentioned
div.p: (The identification of the persons in this list is limited to circumstances and positions under reference in this volume. Names of persons who appear only as the authors of books cited in the volume are not included. Enlisted personnel of the Armed Forces are not included unless they are identified in some special capacity. All titles and positions are American unless there is an indication to the contrary.)
